claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Mestinon (pyridostigmine) is a quaternary carbamate acetylcholinesterase inhibitor that does not appreciably cross cell membranes and has no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
